requirements.text: Resolve the '28P01: password authentication failed for user "postgres"' error occurring during database initialization.
Change the database provider from Npgsql (PostgreSQL) to Microsoft SQL Server in the application configuration.
Update the Program.cs file to use UseSqlServer instead of UseNpgsql for database connection setup.
